reviewType: Independent read-only source and pure-local-test acceptance
scope: v0.3.7: stop at stable physical head, retain collected data, continue upward without repeatedly aligning an unchanged frontier

checks.name: Pure test subset from fixed-SHA archive

findings: Collection finishes only after the existing witness observes a live physical head for six seconds and records two spaced clamped probes. Loading, rendering, root/shell/signature or significant geometry changes invalidate proof.
Unchanged collection frontier/root is anchored once; subsequent batches continue from current scrollTop, so the prior repeated head-shell alignment loop is removed.
At confirmed head, collection stage becomes done directly; there is no newer sweep. Status explicitly retains partial-history wording.

Abort checks surround refresh and precede scrolling; finish clears its poll timer and abort handler; finally disconnects render observer and scroll listener. Existing cancellation/generation tests pass.
Neither done nor cancellation clears IndexStore. Firefox permissions, cache schema, persistence and hydration paths are unchanged; the 31 persistence and 10 background pure cases pass.
testContractNotes: The fixed-SHA top browser harness reuses the 450-normal URL for two starts. Parent confirmed cache contamination of its seventh-entry setup assertion and has isolated URL by pad/start/mode in the working harness without changing runtime sources.

The fixed-SHA delayed browser result contained obsolete newerAfterFirstZero:true metadata despite an explicit no-newer assertion. Parent reports correction to stoppedAtHead:true in the working harness.

The boundary browser contract covers delayed five- and twenty-five-second mounts, frozen middle retry/cancellation, loading and identity/root/height/viewport reset; top contract covers padding, hidden loader, visible busy loading, unknown spacer and late scroll cancellation. These are complementary to the pure witness tests.
limitations: This reviewer did not execute Firefox browser suites; parent is running the isolated native Firefox suites.
No personal Firefox profile, installed personal Firefox extension or user browsing state inspected or operated.
No network Git operation or Git Credential Manager operation executed.

recoveryAppendix.review: Read-only review of original failure, harness corrections and parent-produced corrected native Firefox artifacts
recoveryAppendix.originalObservedFailure: V034-08 timeout with mixed B:u-23..29 and A:u-23..29 in the index
harnessAssessment: Waiting for every ID to match the requested route prefix is justified: mount formerly waited only for the existing host, and a seven-row wait could be satisfied by the previous conversation tail.

Clearing the renderer pending timer when freezing is justified: the former freeze flag prevented future scheduling but did not cancel an already scheduled 130ms render, so an empty mount could be refilled.
recoveryAppendix.baselineComparison: core.ts, persistence.ts and background.ts have no diff between the requested v034 baseline and runtime SHA; DomAdapter read/readRemoved and content collect/restore paths are unchanged.
recoveryAppendix.conclusion: The harness corrections are reasonable and the corrected recovery contract passes on unchanged runtime. No demonstrated v037 product blocker. The exact sole cause of the original failure is not proven; retain its artifact and do not describe it as a confirmed environment failure.
